3 (a) Study Figs 4A, 4B and 4C, which show information about the Lesotho 
Highlands Water Project.
Lesotho is a Less Economically Developed Country (LEDC) in the mountains 
of southern Africa.  It aims to build a series of dams.  These will collect and 
store water to sell to South Africa.  Water will also be used at the dams to 
generate hydro-electric power (HEP).
